newsitem.title: USA: CompuRAD to launch ClinicalWare software.
newsitem.headline: CompuRAD to launch ClinicalWare software.

text.p: CompuRAD Inc said on Thursday that it planned to launch its ClinicalWare software product at a professional meeting the first week of December.

ClinicalWare is based on Digital Equipment Corp's LinkWorks software and is designed to allow doctors using personal computers to call up information, including patient records, laboratory reports and x-rays, from hospital computer networks.
The launch will take place at the annual meeting of the Radiology Society of North America in Chicago, CompuRAD executives said in an interview.
Tucson, Ariz.-based CompuRAD went public in August.
